title: This horse can do it standing up 🐴
caption:
Yes, he can do it standing up. Just not all night 🐴😴
The leg trick is wild 👇
first_comment: Did you know horses take turns sleeping? 🐴👇
sources: Merck Veterinary Manual and the American Association of Equine Practitioners: the stay apparatus and patellar locking let horses rest standing
Equine sleep research summaries (e.g. The Horse / AAEP): horses must lie down for REM sleep and need some recumbent rest daily
Herd behaviour: horses in groups take turns lying down while others stand (equine behaviour literature, e.g. McDonnell, 'The Equid Ethogram')
